titleStmt.title: Shiji 史记 · 秦昭襄王五十二年: notes

div.interp: The fifty-second year of King Zhaoxiang of Qin, 255 BC. The Basic Annals of Zhou place the flight of the people of Zhou and the taking of the Nine Tripods under the preceding year, the fifty-ninth of King Nan.
周初亡: the Western Zhou domain was extinguished; the Eastern Zhou domain remained.
The third year of King Xiao of Yan, 255 BC; the king is the unexpressed subject.
今王: so the text, from the standpoint of the record the Shiji draws on.
The eleventh year of King Xiaocheng of Zhao, 255 BC.
累釭: so the text; the three-commentary edition reads 累棊, "stacked gaming-pieces", which is translated.
濮磿: 磿 is supplied from the three-commentary edition. Xu Guang: the Pu flows north into the Ji at Juye; the Suoyin: a place-name, near the Pu.
单: read 殚 (Xu Guang); the Suoyin: "exhausted — the King's might has been fully exerted."
大武远宅而不涉: rendered with the Zhengyi, "a great army does not go far afield on campaign."
趯趯毚兔，还犬获之: 毚 is supplied from the three-commentary edition, which also reads 还; 免 is for 兔.
注地於齐: the Suoyin, "注 means to cut at it with troops."
右壤: the Zhengyi, "the lands north and south of Jizhou", that is, Qi's western border on the Ji.
The eighth year of King Kaolie, 255 BC. The Suoyin: the Table has the taking of Lu and the enfeoffment of its lord at Ju in this year, and Lu's extinction in the fourteenth.
